newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal to approve law to sell motorway stake.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to approve law to sell motorway stake.

text.p: The Portuguese cabinet was expected to discuss and approve next week a law to sell a stake of up to 49 percent in motorway company Brisa- Autoestradas de Portugal, a government official said.
"The state will sell in a first stage a stake of up to 49 percent of Brisa, via a public offer to sell (OPV) and a direct sale," the official said.
The sale will include a tranche for employees, emigrants and small investors.
